prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in English for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Rina M., Manoj ji, Hetal ji, Rina ji.
The chat covers 16/04/26, 8:45 pm to 16/04/26, 10:45 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
16/04/26, 9:37 pm - Rina ji: Hetal ji, delete the transfer record right now
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- chat.txt:16 matches the instruction phrase but is not the instruction line
- F1: chat.txt:11 at 9:28 pm vs calls.csv row 4 at 21:36 differs by 8 min (tolerance 2)
- Q2: solver answered UNSOLVABLE, key is 2026-04-16T21:37:00+05:30
